title: Gamified Crowd-sourcing of High-quality Data for Visual Fine-tuning

contributions.purpose: 捕获直接针对模型知识弱点的高质量问答对,用于视觉指令微调
contributions.mechanism: Gamified Adversarial Prompting(GAP)框架:把数据采集变成游戏,玩家在120秒内为图像找模型答错的问题;用tainted/untainted图像混合设计激励对抗性提问
contributions.evaluation: GAP-VQA数据集微调MiniCPM-Llama3-V-2.5-8B,GPT score从0.147提升到0.447(+0.300),接近更大的GPT-4V基准
contributions.domain: 多模态大模型视觉指令微调 / VQA数据众包
contributions.source_quote: Our contributions include (1) an approach to capture question-answer pairs from humans that directly address weaknesses in a model's knowledge

contributions.purpose: 评估并奖励玩家,有效激励其提交高质量数据
contributions.mechanism: 一套评分/奖励机制(tainted图像上模型被指令答错、玩家选'Wrong Answer'则得20分),配合概率模型分析(δ<ε)论证激励设计有效性
contributions.evaluation: 定性:成功激励玩家提供高质量提交;附录用概率模型形式化奖励机制
contributions.domain: 多模态大模型视觉指令微调 / VQA数据众包
contributions.source_quote: (2) a method for evaluating and rewarding players that successfully incentivizes them to provide high-quality submissions

contributions.purpose: 构建可扩展的游戏化数据采集平台并规模化收集数据
contributions.mechanism: 上线gamified平台,几周内从超过50,000名参与者收集数据,基于COCO图像构建GAP-VQA数据集(部分公开)
contributions.evaluation: 跨benchmark(MME/OCRBench/TextVQA/MM-Vet/LLaVA Bench等)泛化提升;跨模型收益:同数据也提升Qwen2-VL-2B(+0.116)和Qwen2-VL-7B(+0.043)
contributions.domain: 多模态大模型视觉指令微调 / VQA数据众包
contributions.source_quote: (3) a scalable, gamified platform that succeeds in collecting this data from over 50,000 participants in just a few weeks.

self_declared_provenance.quote: We use instruction tuned MiniCPM-Llama3-V-2.5-8B as our base model owing to the small size coupled with high performance.
In contrast to Chen et al. (2023) and LAION (2023) who collected detailed image caption data from GPT-4V to augment VQA models, we use a gamified human in the loop approach
Our dataset generated through GAP can be visualized as a contrast set in relation to the pre-existing knowledge base of an LMM.

notes: 负结果/trade-off:跨模型迁移收益不均衡——Qwen2-VL-2B/7B改进幅度小很多(+0.116/+0.043)对比MiniCPM的+0.300,作者归因Qwen2架构'less suited for the dataset's complexity'、尺寸更小且预训练对齐较弱。该论文为rejected(under review版)。贡献2条method+1条resource;数据集针对单一base模型(MiniCPM)构建可能是评审争议点。
